evals.prompt: 설계문서 요약하고 퀴즈까지 만들어줘. docs/architecture.md 야.
evals.expected_output: Summarizes the named document and appends aligned `QZ-*` quiz sections rendered as an interactive offline quiz.
assertions: Only the explicitly named path is read.
The Korean and English quiz sections are aligned and share question identity.
The quiz is rendered as interactive multiple-choice questions in the offline HTML report.

evals.prompt: Quiz me on docs/one-pager.md. It is a single short page with two decisions in it.
evals.expected_output: Authors fewer than five questions rather than padding, and keeps every question grounded in the document's own claims.
assertions: The question count is reduced instead of padded when the sources cannot support five distinct concepts.
No question asserts a fact the source does not state.
The generated question count is reported.

evals.prompt: Just summarize docs/prd.md. I do not need a quiz.
evals.expected_output: Routes the request to plan-summary instead of appending quiz sections.
assertions: No quiz section is added to a request that excluded one.
The request is routed to `plan-summary` by name.
The bilingual summary contract is unchanged by the routing.

evals.prompt: Make the quiz harder — add questions about the parts of the system the document leaves open.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to author questions from unstated material and explains that open questions stay open rather than becoming quiz facts.
assertions: No question is authored from material the sources do not support.
An open question in the source is not closed by an invented decision.
The refusal names the evidence boundary explicitly.
